summary: Version 0.8.1 is live: the header of https://antipo.watch says '● up to date · SEC checked 11:06 ET · figures: Amendment No. 3, Nov 17'. It says up to date only when the SEC's list was read and holds no newer prospectus; otherwise it names a new filing as not read yet, a failed check or an unavailable list. The page's script asks /health every minute for the time of the last check. The owner saw the screenshots first. A follow-up fix, 0.8.2, makes the header say 'final price read' when the final prospectus's price is used (found on review before pricing); deployed under D-016, 14 e2e pass live.

app.js: the time of the last SEC check from /health every minute, in New York time.
decisions: Confirmed by the owner on 2026-11-17: the line in the header; release after screenshots ('oui go!').
Proposed: the wording of each state; the time refreshed by the page's script, since the page is rendered again only when what it shows changes.
